title: Community sign-in on vps1: the bridge, its keys, the forum's rules
detail:
DNS for signin.steadyapp.co.za, then the bridge from /opt/steady with the test server as its one practice, the three .env lines on the test server, the Caddy sites, the pinned block in community.yml and a rebuild, and setup.py.
Steps: docs/COMMUNITY.md, "The sign-in bridge".

title: Try the Community tab as the test psychologist, on the web and on a phone
detail: https://test.steadyapp.co.za in a browser (the web tab appears only under steadyapp.co.za), and the newest test APK. Opened straight in a browser, the forum should say it opens inside Steady. The test server's audit report should list each sign-in.

title: Move the sign-in bridge to /opt/steady-ops, from a signed release
detail: It runs from vps1's test checkout until a signed release has it. Move it before the community goes live (docs/COMMUNITY.md, step 2).

title: Take the test psychologist out of the community before it goes live
detail: Remove the address from the test practice's "emails" in /var/lib/steady-signin/config.json, then in the forum: Admin > Users > the test account > Log out (and Suspend).

title: Decide: should forum sessions end by themselves when a Steady account is stopped?
detail: Today Kempie logs people out (Admin > Users > Log out); without Steady they can't come back. The bridge could do it with a forum admin key: one thing less to remember, one more key to guard.

title: Release 1.1.0
detail: On Tiaan's say-so: a pull request from test into main, then deploy/release.sh on his own computer, then the practice servers update. It brings the version numbers, the Community tab and this list to the fleet view.

title: Firebase for Android notifications, before 1.1 reaches a practice
detail: 1.1 removes the old Android push service, so until Firebase (Google's push) is set up, Android phones get no notifications at all. Set up the Firebase project and one service-account key per practice server, or hold 1.1 on practice servers until it's done. Decided on 3 November: every push says only "New notification".

title: Store review of the apps (1.0.2)
detail: In review since 1 November. When each store approves, update app/stores.json, so every server shows the store's version.

title: Store reviewers' notes: point them at test.steadyapp.co.za
detail: The review notes and demo accounts should use test.steadyapp.co.za. Both addresses open vps1's test server until steady.openworks.co.za is retired.

title: Get the lawyer's answers to "Steady: for a lawyer to confirm"
detail: Send the doc, then keep it current: answers go in it, and new questions are added as they come up.

title: Send Kempie "Steady: for Kempie"
detail: What he looks at and what he remembers: the operator agreement, the consent statement, the questionnaires, retention, the community's first day, and logging people out of the forum when they leave a practice.

title: Where does domains.co.za keep the mailbox that sends sign-in codes?
detail: Where the mail host is matters for the list of sub-operators and the lawyer's questions.

title: The security review's morning list: confirm each one is done
detail:
- vps2 installs only signed releases (audit-server.sh says so)
- the corrected privacy policy is published
- steadyapp.co.za: the extra A record gone, HTTPS enforced
- SPF, DKIM, DMARC and CAA records for steadyapp.co.za
- GitHub: the web-dist ruleset; steadyapp's alerts and its main ruleset
- Play Console: the Data safety deletion link

title: Split CI into a build job and a publish job
detail: Left open in the security review (F2, F12): a build job without write rights, and a release-time rebuild of the web app to compare with what CI published.

title: Try PocketBase with a read-only file system on vps1
detail: Decided in the security review: read-only after a trial on vps1. Then through test to the practice servers.

title: Kempie reads the Science section before the community opens
detail: 15 topics in community/topics/science/, posted to the test forum. His checks: the design-history wording and the ethics sentence (RADR basis), the WHO-5 "Very low wellbeing (28 or less)" band, the PCL-5 10-point note and item 16, the low-mood rule, the 14-day window, the breathing cautions, and RADR's open questions. Then he posts his own welcome (community/drafts/kempie-welcome.md).

title: Out of hours: notifications go out at any hour
detail: There are no quiet hours in the server or the push relay. Each practice needs a policy for an item 9 answer that arrives at night or over a weekend; the Science and flags topics say so. Decide with Kempie whether Steady should offer quiet hours.

title: A check-in made while the server can't be reached is lost
detail: The plan is that the apps keep working when the server is offline and send once it's back. Today only watch data waits on the phone; a check-in or questionnaire answer shows "Couldn't send that, try again" and isn't kept.

title: HRV: the RADR tab says it's used, the app never reads it
detail: app/lib/ui/clinician/radr_tab.dart and docs/RADR.md say the heart domain uses HRV when the watch provides it. The app doesn't read HRV and the server drops it (lib/wearable.js METRICS). Fix the wording, or add HRV.

title: Low-mood rule: the list and the notification count differently
detail: The patient list's flag uses check-ins from the last 15 days; the note on a check-in's notification uses the last three, however old (lib/server.js summaryOf and the checkins hook in steady.pb.js). Agree one rule with Kempie.

title: Imported questionnaires: can't be edited, and copies skip the licence check
detail: library_screen.dart doesn't let an imported instrument be edited (the server would), so an imported PHQ-8 has no bands or flags. "Use as a starting point" saves a copy as the practice's own, which skips the licence confirmation.

title: WHO-5: the "Very low wellbeing (28 or less)" band
detail: In the literature, 28 or less is a stricter depression screen, not a wellbeing level; the 2024 WHO guidance only suggests below 50. Kempie to confirm the label and its red flag.

title: A patient on UTC is read as South African time
detail: getInt("tzOffset") || 120 treats an offset of 0 as missing. Small: affects only patients whose phone is set to UTC.

title: The website's science and community pages are out of date
detail: steadyapp.co.za/science says check-ins aren't scored (RADR scores them, and there's a low-mood flag), that Steady doesn't alert anyone outside office hours (pushes go out at any hour), and doesn't mention RADR. /community still says invitation only and authenticator-app sign-in.

title: docs/RADR.md names the AI note-taking product
detail: The paperwork names no product; the app says "Export for AI note-taking". Reword docs/RADR.md the same way.

title: The RADR method note (radr-1) is out of date
detail: It still says research-only, that RADR isn't stored, that the iPhone app isn't built and that sign-off is pending. Update it from docs/RADR.md and the Science topics.

title: Lawyer: the forum's terms of service and privacy page
detail: Discourse's terms now name OpenWorks IT (Pty) Ltd, South African law and Gqeberha for disputes; its privacy page is still Discourse's generic text. Both to be checked, with a short Steady Community privacy notice to replace the generic one.
